description_en: Modifies the proxy performance level of a specified PolarDB cluster and supports scheduled execution
description_zh: 调整指定 PolarDB 集群的代理性能级别，支持通过计划时间安排执行
name: RefreshProxyLevel

parameters.help_en: The earliest time to start the proxy upgrade, in the YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ format (UTC). Usage notes: If the DBClusterStatus of the cluster is not Running, you must specify both the PlannedStartTime and PlannedEndTime parameters to create a scheduled task. The description of the FromTimeService parameter specifies that the task can be executed immediately only when the cluster is in the Running state and FromTimeService is set to true
parameters.help_zh: 计划开始执行代理规格升级的最早时间，格式为 YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ（UTC）。调用说明：集群状态条件说明：当集群 DBClusterStatus 不为 Running 时必须提供这两个参数以创建定时任务；同时在 FromTimeService 参数 description 中说明仅当集群为 Running 状态时 FromTimeService=true 才可直接执行
parameters.name: planned_start_time

parameters.help_en: The latest time to start the proxy upgrade, in the YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ format (UTC). Usage notes: If the DBClusterStatus of the cluster is not Running, you must specify both the PlannedStartTime and PlannedEndTime parameters to create a scheduled task. The description of the FromTimeService parameter specifies that the task can be executed immediately only when the cluster is in the Running state and FromTimeService is set to true
parameters.help_zh: 计划开始执行代理规格升级的最晚时间，格式为 YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ（UTC）。调用说明：集群状态条件说明：当集群 DBClusterStatus 不为 Running 时必须提供这两个参数以创建定时任务；同时在 FromTimeService 参数 description 中说明仅当集群为 Running 状态时 FromTimeService=true 才可直接执行
parameters.name: planned_end_time

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether the execution is initiated by the scheduled task service. Default value: false. If this parameter is set to false and PlannedStartTime is specified, a scheduled task is created. If this parameter is set to true, the task is executed immediately. Usage notes: If the DBClusterStatus of the cluster is not Running, you must specify the PlannedStartTime and PlannedEndTime parameters to create a scheduled task. The description of this parameter specifies that the task can be executed immediately only when the cluster is in the Running state and this parameter is set to true
parameters.help_zh: 是否为定时任务服务发起的执行。默认 false；false 且指定 PlannedStartTime 时创建定时任务，true 时直接执行。调用说明：集群状态条件说明：当集群 DBClusterStatus 不为 Running 时必须提供这两个参数以创建定时任务；同时在 FromTimeService 参数 description 中说明仅当集群为 Running 状态时 FromTimeService=true 才可直接执行
parameters.name: from_time_service

parameters.help_en: The target proxy performance level. Valid values: ProxyStandard, ProxyStandardx2, and ProxyStandardx4
parameters.name: proxy_target_class
